description: Fetch the actual code for one section, plus its file context (imports at the top of the file). Use during TEACH mode to walk the user through their code one section at a time, and during INTERVIEW mode to ground questions in the real code. After the user demonstrates understanding of a section in teach mode, call mark_covered — this tool does not mark automatically.

section_id.description: Section id from list_sections or ingest_repo
